title: How Saint Patrick's Day Became a Global Party
shared_passage: Watch a video about Saint Patrick's day, and for questions 1 to 5, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: According to the video...
options: Saint Patrick's day celebrates Irish people who emigrated.
Japan, Russia and Argentina are the countries with more Irish descendants.
around 70 million Irish people have left Ireland over the years.

questions.question: Saint Patrick's day celebration...
options: started in different countries at the same time.

questions.question: One of the secrets of Saint Patrick's success is...
Guinness...
options: has built a lot of Irish pubs around the world.
has helped people who wanted to open Irish pubs.

questions.question: Ireland's ministers...
options: will promote Ireland around the world.
are using Saint Patrick to promote Ireland.
